tools.description: Do the work on a priority, and resolve routine asks with undo. Ship records completion; it deploys nothing. Skill: annsa-working (annsa.ask skill=working). [production · app.annsa.ai · tools 0ab54891]

action.description: ship: Records completion, with pr_url and learned. Deploys nothing; retract undoes it. claim: Takes the seat, mints a thin spec and returns holder_key (send it on write and ship); work another holds needs takeover and a reason. note: Appends a note; sets next_action and pr_url. A correction is a new note with supersedes. handoff: Passes the held spec to another agent or person. dispatch: Posts @claude on the priority's linked GitHub issue and hands the seat to Claude Code; the person stays assigned. unclaim: Puts the work down with a reason; nothing is marked shipped. write: Replaces one spec section as a new version; text for a section that is not yours is recorded as an update. verify: Records how a line was checked, by proof kind. No ship gate. escalate: Raises a three-line ask with a trigger in a person's Needs you; decides nothing. Needs `checked`: a fact you can check is not asked. One open ask per priority; the same topic updates it. resolve: Answers a routine ask the way your principles already decide it; returns use_id for undo. undo: Puts back your own resolve by use_id.
